purpose: Measure the user-downloaded Warehouse SDS-50J mesh flange against the rear plate at the revision-13 and revision-14 plate datums.
method: Four flange-corner rays per DIN cast inward along the connector axis in frame 1; plate frame normal Z outward, inner face at slab minimum. Positive = flange inside plate material; negative = gap. Same sampling as the revision-13 downloaded-fit review.
